intro: Sembawang Portico is an HDB BTO project in Sembawang, launched on 16 June 2026 in the same sales exercise as Sembawang Brook. The official confirmation is for the launch date only, not for TOP or keys. Our file notes that completion is unconfirmed and generally beyond 2027. A unit count is not in our file, so it is left blank, as is tenure. Your HDB documents remain the source of truth for typologies. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Sembawang Portico renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Sembawang Portico interior
sections.text:
The name “Portico” is not treated as a confirmed architectural or typologies feature, and we will not invent a typical Portico layout. When the official plan is in hand, the work Maison would start with is the same serious first fit-out as any new BTO in this town: a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry shoe cabinet, and a living-room storage wall, designed as built-in carpentry rather than as loose, flat-pack furniture. We can present the look in a wide view or in closer material shots, depending on what you need to decide. No official floor plan is on file.

Sembawang Brook is the sister June 2026 page; Sembawang Anchor is a later, November 2026 launch in the same town and should not be used as a typologies or waiting-time guide for Portico. We will not invent walking times to Sembawang town, to the park, or to any MRT station. Check your eventual block and facing before you plan blinds or a window bench.

Because keys are generally still some years off, the useful work now is to keep the official plan and to freeze a design when you are ready, not to book a contractor against a guessed year. After keys, inspect defects and obtain the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after approvals, as an editorial figure only. WhatsApp Maison with your official plan when you have it. We are not affiliated with HDB.

faq.a: Our project file records: 2026-06-16 launch. That official confirmation covers the launch date only, not TOP or key collection.

faq.q: Do you have the Sembawang Portico floor plan?
